name: future-props-lab
description: 未来道具研究所模型基础设施管理台

scripts.build:desktop: uv run python desktop/scripts/build_backend.py --check-assets && npm run build:desktop --workspace web && uv run python desktop/scripts/build_backend.py && npm run build --workspace desktop
scripts.package:desktop: uv run python desktop/scripts/build_backend.py --check-assets && npm run build:desktop --workspace web && uv run python desktop/scripts/build_backend.py && npm run package --workspace desktop
scripts.test:desktop: npm run compile --workspace desktop && uv run pytest -q tests/test_configuration.py tests/test_desktop.py tests/test_desktop_agent.py tests/test_desktop_development.py && npm run test --workspace desktop
scripts.setup: python3 scripts/check_lfs_assets.py --tool && uv sync --all-groups && npm install && npm run voice-vad:sync --workspace web && python3 scripts/check_lfs_assets.py --all
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm run contracts:generate --workspace web && npm run sdk:generate
scripts.contracts:check: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py --check && npm run contracts:check --workspace web && npm run sdk:check
scripts.test: uv run pytest -q && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check backend db scripts tests sdk/python/src desktop/backend desktop/scripts && npm run lint --workspace web && npm run lint --workspace desktop
scripts.format: uv run ruff format backend db scripts tests sdk/python/src desktop/backend desktop/scripts && npm run format --workspace web && npm run format --workspace desktop
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check backend db scripts tests sdk/python/src desktop/backend desktop/scripts && npm run format:check --workspace web && npm run format:check --workspace desktop
scripts.build: python3 scripts/check_lfs_assets.py --web && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.sdk:generate: uv run python scripts/generate_sdk.py && uv run python scripts/generate_sdk_docs.py
scripts.sdk:check: uv run python scripts/generate_sdk.py --check && uv run python scripts/generate_sdk_docs.py --check
scripts.docs:check: uv run python scripts/generate_sdk_docs.py --check && npm run test --workspace web -- tests/docs-rendering.test.tsx
scripts.verify-notes: npm run verify-agent-note-tree && npm run verify-agent-note-format && npm run verify-archived
scripts.test:sdk: uv run pytest -q tests/test_python_sdk.py tests/test_workshop_operations.py tests/test_model_inference.py tests/test_automation_exports.py tests/test_sdk_workflows.py
